changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION data.get_order_id(p_code_symbol character varying, p_side character varying, p_qty numeric) RETURNS int8 LANGUAGE sql AS $$ /* Return last known orderId. */ select ds.orderid from ( select ta.ts_bybit, o.*, row_number() over(order by ta.ts_bybit desc) as rn from data.bb_order o join data.trade_advice_order ta on ta.orderid = o.orderid where o.side = p_side and o.symbol = p_code_symbol and abs(o.qty) - abs(p_qty) < 0.6 and -- not yet closed not exists( select 1 from data.trade_advice tai where tai.to_close_orderid = o.orderid and exists( select 1 from data.trade_advice_order tao where tao.id_trade_advice = tai.id ) ) ) ds where rn=1; $$ ;
